moments.label: Wait with him
lines: There is still time to walk slowly.
moments.kept: At the last warm hearth, he held out his hand. We stopped for a while.

moments.label: Wait with him
lines: She stops. He takes one more step before he notices.
moments.kept: In the hollow, we waited. He came back without being called.

moments.label: Stay a little longer
lines: He keeps his coat on beside the fire.
She does not ask him to take it off.
moments.kept: The dripping stopped. He kept his coat on. We stayed.

moments.label: Wait with him
lines: She stays until he is ready.
moments.kept: Out of the rain, he made room. There was nowhere else we needed to be just then.

moments.label: Let him take your hand
moments.kept: In the garden, he reached for my hand first. I waited for him.
